_comment: Single source of truth for business facts and the booking destination. Edit here; never in the templates. Run `node build.mjs` after changes. Items marked CONFIRM in docs/LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md need owner confirmation before launch.
_baseUrl_note: UNCONFIRMED production domain (inherited from the prototype; no DNS record exists as of 2026-10-21). Change to the real domain before deploying. Must be https:// with no trailing slash.

contact._email_note: CONFIRM — no public email is known. Leave empty to omit; the privacy page then points to phone and post.

geo._source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim, building outline for Κολοκοτρώνη 10 (way 762742110), queried 2026-10-21

hours._source: ebarber.gr listing, read 2026-10-21. CONFIRM with owner before launch.

services._source: ebarber.gr listing, read 2026-10-21. Prices in EUR. CONFIRM with owner; set showPrices to false to publish the list without prices.
services._surcharge_note: ebarber lists +3 EUR per service on Christmas/Easter/14 August. Set to 0 to hide the note. CONFIRM.

legal._controllerLegalName_note: CONFIRM — the legal entity or sole trader name operating the shop. Empty = pages show the trade name and flag the gap in the checklist; do not launch with it empty.
legal._hosting_note: CONFIRM — name and location of the hosting provider and its log retention. Empty = the privacy page uses generic wording and the checklist flags it.
legal._logRetention_note: CONFIRM — e.g. el: "τυπικά έως 30 ημέρες", en: "typically no longer than 30 days". Empty = sentence ends at the provider policy.
